readings.Aries: Rest is not retreat. Your system needs to cycle before it can perform at capacity again. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Taurus: Something you made with your hands or your time is more significant than you're giving it credit for. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Gemini: The distraction is real and deliberate. You know what you're distracting yourself from. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Cancer: Your memory holds things gently that others would have dropped. Today that gift is needed. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Leo: The spotlight is available today. The question is what you want to do in it. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Virgo: The research phase of this decision is complete. The decision phase requires something research can't provide. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: The beauty you've cultivated around yourself serves you. It also occasionally distracts from what's underneath. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: You do not give second chances easily. In this case, one more data point might be warranted. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been talking about the future in a way that lets you avoid the present. Notice this. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Capricorn: The thing you are in service of — your family, your work, your future self — check that it still deserves the service. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Aquarius: The thing you're resisting because it seems too normal — normal isn't the problem. Examine the actual resistance. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like surrendering is actually arriving. Let yourself arrive. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
